evidence.title: Supaste — Clipboard History Manager for Mac

name: Supaste
summary: Local-first clipboard and screenshot history app for Mac with search, OCR, multi-clip copy, clip reminders and iCloud sync.
description: A local-first clipboard and screenshot history manager for Mac. Saves copied text, links, images, files, code and colors into a searchable visual timeline grouped by type, app and custom categories. Reach clips through a notch shelf, quick search, inline paste, drag and drop or the full Library view; adds screenshot and image OCR, multi-clip copy, inline shortcuts, clip reminders and iCloud sync. One-time purchase; works fully offline.
contains: local-first clipboard and screenshot history app for macOS Sonoma 14.0 or later
saves text, links, images, files, code and colors; grouped by type, app and custom categories
notch shelf, quick search, inline paste, drag and drop and a full Library view
screenshot and image OCR, multi-clip copy, inline shortcuts, clip reminders
iCloud sync; Apple Intelligence; fully offline and private (site claims)
#4 on Product Hunt; Honorable Mention (badges on site)
